rawError: Error: OAuth provider callback failed while resolving /api/auth for the login flow.

hypotheses.summary: The login page could retry the failed callback request.
evidence: The visible error starts after the login action.
The route handler still fails when called directly.
hypotheses.rejectionReason: A retry hides the symptom but does not repair the provider callback configuration.

hypotheses.summary: The auth route and shared auth helper disagree about provider callback handling.
evidence: lib/auth.ts owns the provider configuration used by the route.
The User Login graph node redirects to profile and dashboard after auth succeeds.

proposedFix.summary: Normalize provider callback handling in the auth route and shared auth helper instead of adding a UI retry.

verification.outputSummary: Presentation fixture marks the auth route and helper repair as verified.
